build_flags.detail: 242 of 242 translation units do NOT carry -ffp-contract=off (first: ../../src/Core/AI.m). Without it clang may fuse a*b+c into a single FMA, which rounds once instead of twice and changes the low bits of every float in the dump - exactly the cross-platform variation the golden policy exists to remove.

frame_differential.note: Two launches of the identical scene sit at 0.32x tolerance; removing the expansion moves the frame 25.4x beyond it - an 80-fold separation between noise and signal. The absent arm is corroborated independently: its evidence block has shader_uniform_sets_positive=false, shader_compile_failures=[], glsl_driver_log=[] and oxp_standards_errors=0, i.e. no shader of any kind was built and the expansion was not on the search path at all.
frame_differential.tolerance_source: tests/golden/frame_hash.derive_tolerance() over tests/golden/calibration.json (bead oo-ae9); NEVER adjusted by this bead

note: Scenario 009 shaders (bead oo-rad): stages the in-tree shaderFallbackTest OXP, puts its cube on a mission screen pinned to the literal [shipKey] role, and proves FROM THE ENGINE AND THE GL DRIVER that GLSL is live and that the expansion own shader source reached the compiler. Positive anti-vacuity evidence: [shader.uniform.set] lines (OOShaderMaterial.m:327, reachable only after compile+link both returned GL_TRUE) plus the GL driver own glGetInfoLogARB text naming the fixture syntax error. SCOPE: this golden does NOT cover a SUCCESSFUL OXP shader painting pixels - the only shader test-OXP in this tree ships an intentionally invalid shader, and the red cube in frame.png is the fixture own documented no-shader outcome. 10/10 runs byte-identical. renderer.note: The golden harness forces LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE=1 / GALLIUM_DRIVER=llvmpipe (console.py:_env), which is also the rasteriser bead oo-ae9 calibrated the frame tolerance against. The same box also has an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Ti driving GL 4.6.0/560.94 when the software override is absent, and reports "Shaders are supported." there too - so this scenario is NOT limited to software rendering, it is pinned to it for tolerance comparability.
